A meal of white rice with a yellow chicken curry, plus a separate bowl of creamy chunky salad, likely potato salad. Water contributes no energy.

### 2. Vessels

- **Salad bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**. This appears to be part of the meal, rather than an unrelated dish at the image edge.

### 8. Sanity check
